:::{#exm-weighted-average}
#### A course grade

A course grade counts the midterm for $1/4$ and the final for $3/4$.
A student scores $70$ on the midterm and $90$ on the final.
The weights $1/4$ and $3/4$ are non-negative and add to $1$,
so the grade is a weighted average of $70$ and $90$:

$$
\ba
\frac{1}{4} \cd 70 + \frac{3}{4} \cd 90
&= 17.5 + 67.5
&& \text{(multiply each score by its weight)}
\\
&= 85
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

The grade $85$ lies between $70$ and $90$, and nearer to $90$, which has the larger weight.

:::
